summary: Your track decides the track courses and the theory and methods courses, which need a B+ or better. The audit also checks ANTHRO 310G for three quarters, four 5-unit ANTHRO electives numbered 200 or above, and ANTHRO 441 with a B or better. Your graduate units must reach 45 with a B or better in each course: none below the 100 level, at least 23 units at the 200 or 300 level, at most 5 units S/NC, at most 10 units of directed reading, and at least 30 units in ANTHRO, since at most 15 may come from related areas or overseas study. You check by hand the paper proposal and master's paper, the B average, your advisor and Plan of Study Form, and for the terminal MA three quarters of full-tuition enrollment. ANTHRO 299 is only recommended.
